mapper.sql: factor_id AS factorId, case_id AS caseId, factor_code AS factorCode, factor_value AS factorValue, score, source, recorded_by AS recordedBy, recorded_time AS recordedTime, create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_dd_risk_factor(factor_id, case_id, factor_code, factor_value, score, source, recorded_by, recorded_time, create_time) VALUES(#{row.factorId}, #{row.caseId}, #{row.factorCode}, #{row.factorValue}, #{row.score}, #{row.source}, #{row.recordedBy}, #{row.recordedTime}, #{row.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_dd_risk_factor WHERE case_id = #{caseId} ORDER BY factor_code, factor_value
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_dd_risk_factor WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND source = #{source}
